items.source: NestedTransactionNotSupportedException - if the underlying transaction does not support savepoints
items.translation: NestedTransactionNotSupportedException - 如果底层事务不支持保存点

items.source: The savepoint will not be automatically released afterwards. You may explicitly call releaseSavepoint(Object) or rely on automatic release on transaction completion.
items.translation: 保存点之后将不会自动释放。您可以显式调用releaseSavepoint(Object)，或者依赖事务完成时的自动释放。
注意，保存点只能在活动事务内工作。对于高级需求，仅使用这种程序化保存点处理；否则，带有 `PROPAGATION_NESTED` 的子事务更可取。

items.source:
This interface is inspired by JDBC's Savepoint mechanism
but is independent of any specific persistence technology.
items.translation: 该接口受 JDBC 的 Savepoint 机制启发，但独立于任何特定的持久化技术。

items.source:
Note that most transaction managers will automatically release
savepoints at transaction completion.
items.translation: 请注意，大多数事务管理器会在事务完成时自动释放保存点。

items.source:

items.translation: 请注意，大多数事务管理器会在事务完成时自动释放保存点。

items.source:
Implementations should fail as silently as possible if proper
resource cleanup will eventually happen at transaction completion.
items.translation: 如果适当的资源清理最终会在事务完成时发生，实现应尽可能静默地失败。

items.source: a savepoint object, to be passed into rollbackToSavepoint(Object) or releaseSavepoint(Object)
items.translation: 一个保存点对象，将传递给rollbackToSavepoint(Object)或releaseSavepoint(Object)。

items.source: TransactionException - if the savepoint could not be created, for example because the transaction is not in an appropriate state
items.translation: TransactionException - 如果无法创建保存点，例如因为事务未处于适当状态。

items.source: TransactionException - if the rollback failed
items.translation: TransactionException - 如果回滚失败

items.source: TransactionException - if the release failed
items.translation: TransactionException - 如果释放失败
